import numpy as np


def pack(result):
    e, u = result
    e, u = np.asarray(e), np.asarray(u)

    assert u.shape == (len(k), 2, 2)
    projectors = np.einsum("kan,kbn->knab", u, u.conj())
    return np.concatenate((e.ravel(), projectors.ravel()))
